In this special episode of The Ranveer Show, we celebrate Krishna Janmashtami by welcoming Vinay Varanasi, a Bengaluru-based storyteller and artist deeply rooted in Sanatan Dharma, spirituality, and Indian culture. Today, we delve into the fascinating life of Sri Krishna, revered as the sustainer of the universe.

Join us as we explore the various aspects of Sri Krishna's life, from his miraculous birth to his roles as a divine hero and a guide in the Bhagavad Gita. We discuss the deep symbolism and the enthralling stories associated with his life, shedding light on his teachings and the profound impact they have on spiritual practices.
